question: The BMW Rules 2016 prescribe autoclaving at a minimum temperature of 121°C for at least 60 minutes as a standard pre-treatment method for infectious biomedical waste.

l10n.wrongAnswerMessage: This statement is true. The BMW Rules 2016 specify autoclaving at 121°C for a minimum of 60 minutes for infectious biomedical waste. Remember: 121°C, 60 min, 15 psi steam pressure.
l10n.correctAnswerMessage: Correct. Autoclaving at 121°C for ≥60 minutes (or equivalent validated cycles) is the prescribed treatment for infectious waste (yellow and red bag waste). This renders it non-infectious before final disposal.
